title: Draw Me Nearer
lyrics: Verse 1:
[G]I am Thine, [D7]O Lord, I have heard [G]thy voice,
And it [C]told Thy love to [G]me;
But I long [D7]to rise in the arms [G]of faith
And be [C]closer [D]drawn [D7]to [G]Thee.
Verse 2:
[G]Draw me nearer, [C]nearer, blessed [G]Lord,
To the [C]cross [G]where [D7]Thou [G]hast [D]died.
[G]Draw me nearer, nearer, [C]nearer, blessed Lord,
To Thy [G]precious, [D]bleeding [G]side.
Verse 3:
Consecrate me now to thy service, Lord,
by the power of grace divine;
let my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
and my will be lost in thine.
Verse 4:
O the pure delight of a single hour
that before thy throne I spend,
when I kneel in prayer, and with thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend!
